description.narrative: Contribute to the strengthening of rule of law, governance and the respect of human rights in Colombia through comprehensive strengthening of the National Police of Colombia in key areas.

Cooperation between Swedish and Colombian police within three areas. Strengthening of the preventive and investigative capacity regarding intrafamiliar and gender based violence. Strengthening of community policing. Development of internal training primarilly within the areas of human rights and gender issues.

Samarbete mellan svensk och colombiansk polis inom tre områden. Stärkande av den preventiva och investigativa kapaciteten avseende intrafamiljärt och genderbaserat våld. Stärkande av närpolisverksamheten. Utveckling av internutbildning främst inom områdena mänskliga rättigheter och genderfrågor.

The project on Swedish and Colombian Police cooperation have proceeded satisfactory with results in its five main components: 1) Domestic and sexual violence; 2) Community Police; 3) Technique to reduce stress; 4) Police Education and 5) Leadership. The following results are reported within the specific components: 1) Within the domestic and sexual violence component, 201 Colombian police men and women have been trained, including 10 training of trainers to multiple the knowledge of how o deal with domestic violence cases within the Colombian Police. Previously, domestic and sexual violence was rather unknown and this component has therefore supported Colombian police on how to deal with the cases on domestic and sexual violence. 2) Community police: This component has resulted in 200 police officers at local level being trained in the components of the project. This in turn, has resulted in a more profound analysis of the causes of committed crimes as well as increased coordination with corresponding local authorities and agencies. 3) Methodology for police officers to reduce stress in interventions: 130 police instructors as well as 258 trainer of trainers and 38 900 police officers have been trained in this methodology that ultimately seek to reduce police violence and increase confidence for the police. Another important result is the inclusion of the specific methodology in the police curricula of the the Colombian police academy. At a more general level this component has increased security and less use of police violence for women, men, girls and boys in Colombia. 4) Police education: This component has resulted in police officers from all Police Schools in Colombia being trained in more practical teaching methods for increased learning and results among students in the police academy. 5) Leadership: This component added to the project in 2016 has resulted in totally 29 police officers trained in leadership in Sweden. Apart from the leadership skills acquired, the trained police officers have functioned as "spokes persons" for the project within the Colombian police that have facilitated the overall progress of the project. Apart from these specific results, the project has resulted in an increased ownership from the Colombian police reflected in the management of the project as well as the Colombian police contributions to the project, such as staff members working with the project employed by the Colombian police and provision of office space and aulas for teaching within the premises of the Colombian police.
